brief: Apply an explicit camera mode index, preserving callback writes.
decl: void record_mode_apply(RecordMachine &machine, std::span<const std::byte> pairs, std::span<const std::byte, 36> modes, std::span<const std::byte, 12> context, std::uint32_t mode, std::uint32_t &counter0, std::uint32_t &counter1, std::uint32_t index);

bookkeeping.scope: Complete controller body, actual recovered children, and declared observation/mutation substitutions for callback handlers.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Explicit signed nonnegative index; >=9 returns before current-record reads. Otherwise valid nonnull current record, stable caller-owned arena, disjoint terminated pairs, nine mode words and context, distinct external counters. Low mode byte selects the special-23 behavior.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 1155 complete original-body cases exact on MSVC and Zig/Clang under declared callback substitutions; eight separate six-call lifecycle traces also match. See docs/recovery/camera-cycling.md.
unresolved: Actual callback bodies, authentic UI/input producers, and integrated camera updates.
Negative table accesses, original pointer faults and unsupported memory windows.
